[[Crion]], the [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of [[Telos IV]], formed an army towards the end of his life in an effort to ascertain power and ultimate authority on Telos. Crion successfully appealed to his son, [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Xanatos]] to side with him when the latter and his [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] came to the planet to mediate an end to a [[Telosian Civil War|civil war]].

The army was disbanded when Jinn [[Shiak|impaled]] Crion and Xanatos, who had fallen to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], fled the planet for parts unknown only to resurface as the head of the [[Offworld Mining Corporation]].
